Safe routine for later chapters后续章节保险流程

Keep two rotating manual saves. Before every departure, clear short requests, inspect green map events, buy the current Liberl News, check shops and NPC dialogue for books and recipes, then compare the chest milestone.保留两个轮换手动存档。每次离开前清掉短期委托、检查绿色地图事件、购买当期《利贝尔通讯》、查看商店与 NPC 对话中的书籍和料理，再核对宝箱里程碑。
